title: Software Engineer (Cybersecurity Integrations) - Armis
text:
Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
This isn’t a role for someone who just builds standard API connectors. As a Cybersecurity Integration Engineer (Conventional and AI native), you will be bridging the gap between conventional security stacks and next-generation, AI-driven insights. You will design and deploy standard integrations and intelligent agents that do more than move data; they transform raw, fragmented telemetry into a cohesive, actionable risk posture. You will be the creator of automated reasoning within our integration layer, ensuring that our customers don’t just have data—they have the right insights and actionable intelligence.
You will work alongside the team to redefine and transform how integration is developed in Armis.
What You’ll Do
Collaborate with senior engineers to build and maintain scalable, resilient integrations (APIs, webhooks, streaming data) across the security ecosystem.
Implement modern design patterns and best practices to support AI-native integration workflows and automated threat handling.
Assist in troubleshooting customer friction points and systematically resolve edge cases within integration services.
Contribute to reusable libraries and data-mapping frameworks to enable standard connections across enterprise security tools.
Partner with cross-functional R&D and Product teams under technical guidance to implement features that improve automated risk management.
Help enhance existing integration components to support low-code and self-service capabilities.
Qualifications
Requirements
2 to 5 years of Python engineering expertise with a focus on building production-grade, maintainable codebases. Cyber Security experience is a plus
Deep networking fundamentals, including strong knowledge of TCP/IP and L3-L7 protocols.
Experience with high-throughput, enterprise-scale distributed systems, Async and synchronous programming.
A product-minded approach: you don’t just write code; you solve critical problems for our customer base.
Preferred: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Kafka/message queues, and LLM-powered application development (RAG, agentic workflows).
Bring a proactive "can-do" attitude combined with a mindset focused on continuous learning and innovation.
In accordance with our hybrid work policy, this position requires on-site office attendance a few times each week.
Additional Information
Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
Equal Opportunity Employer
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
text:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About Agent Studio

Agent Studio helps Razorpay merchants run AI agents across payments, checkout, disputes, subscriptions, reconciliation, risk, and customer workflows. We take the messy, undocumented work merchants do every day and turn it into reliable production agents.

The role

We're hiring a Forward-Deployed Engineer who is equal parts engineer, solution consultant, and merchant partner — the single technical owner of the merchant relationship. Engineer accessible, testable, observable, secure, reliable, and performant experiences, while diagnosing issues methodically. Collaborate proactively across Product, Design, Backend, Platform, and UI teams, manage dependencies and trade-offs, mentor engineers, improve standards and processes, and create reusable mechanisms that raise team effectiveness. Operate what you build by supporting production, investigating incidents, strengthening monitoring and runbooks, and continuously improving operational excellence.

title: iOS Engineer
text:
About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.

The Role

We're looking for an iOS Engineer to build and scale the Atlys iOS app, helping millions of travellers apply for visas faster and with less uncertainty, right from their phones.

This role is for someone with a strong foundation in native iOS development who obsesses over performance, polish and reliability, and who enjoys owning features end to end.

The Job

 - Build and ship core app experiences in Swift and SwiftUI across the visa journey, from discovery and document upload to payments and application tracking.

 - Own app quality and performance, keeping launch time, crash rates, memory usage and app size in check across devices, iOS versions and network conditions.

 - Bring AI into the app by turning AI-powered flows such as smart document capture, conversational assistance into fast, native experiences.

 - Ship fast with product, design and backend, running experiments and iterating on features based on data.

 - Raise the engineering bar through clean architecture, thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

The Ideal Candidate

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 3-5 years of iOS development experience, including shipping and scaling at least one consumer app on the App Store.

 - Are exceptionally strong in Swift, including Swift Concurrency (async/await), with hands-on experience in SwiftUI and UIKit.

 - Have a solid grasp of modern app architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture or TCA), dependency injection and modularisation with Swift Package Manager.

 - Have built robust networking and data layers using REST/GraphQL APIs, URLSession, Core Data or SwiftData, and offline-first patterns.

 - Know how to measure and improve app health using tools such as Xcode Instruments, Firebase Crashlytics, XCTest and analytics or experimentation SDKs.

Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

 - Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

 - A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

 - Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

 - Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

 - Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

 - Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.

 - An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel
